title: NoteForge AI
shortDescription: AI pipeline that converts YouTube video content into notes, mind maps, and quiz-oriented study material.
description: NoteForge AI is a full-stack application with a React frontend and a TypeScript/Express backend focused on long-form video understanding. It uses a hybrid LLM approach with LangChain/LangGraph orchestration, queueing, and transcript processing to generate structured learning artifacts.
myContributions: Engineered the end-to-end YouTube-to-notes processing workflow.
Implemented hybrid LLM routing and queue-based generation orchestration.
Built the React interface and backend APIs for generation and export flows.
